scope: Reject incompatible resume tool-set changes instead of pretending Codex supports dynamicTools hot-update on thread/resume.
Require matching SDK tools after adapter restart when the persisted runtime mapping was created with tools.
Bound adapter and Codex gateway transcripts through a transcriptLimit ring buffer.
Add protocol-v3 pending dynamic tool timeout so a missing SDK tool result does not leak pending state forever.
Stop JSON-stringifying arbitrary object tool results into Codex inputText when textResultForLlm is absent.
Expose CODEX_ADAPTER_TRANSCRIPT_LIMIT and document the production locked lane, codex login pre-step, durable resume store, and safe defaults.
